titles.title: Fair Audits and Inspections for Regulators' Exams Act
Fair Audits and Inspections for Regulators' Exams Act
A bill to amend the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council Act of 1978 to provide for fair audits and inspections for examinations.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
